term: God-like (Gödel's 1970 G, the definition God; Lean `GodLike`, shared with Scott's)
definition: `GodLike P x w`: at world w, x has every property that is positive at w (AFP definition God, G x ≡ ❙∀φ. P φ ❙⊃ φ x). The formula is Scott's G, so the Lean declaration is shared; what it picks out depends on the positivity constant, which here is the 1970 theory's (DEF-POSITIVE-PROPERTY-GOEDEL-1970). The theory names the definition 'God'; the formalized notion is only this.
